properties.NAME: MONTANA (Ks Terr)
properties.CHANGE: MONTANA (Kansas Territory, extinct) created by Kansas Territory from ARAPAHOE (Kansas Territory, extinct); MONTANA was located entirely within present Colorado. Act passed 7 Feb 1859, took effect 1 Mar 1859.
properties.CITATION: Kans. Terr. Laws 1859, 5th leg., ch. 44, secs. 1, 7/pp. 357-359; Bancroft, 402
